evidence: Seed holds no records: environment/assets/seed_data.json is {"snippets": [], "note": ...}. The reference never seeds the database: solution/solve.sh deletes /app/app.db and copies the app; server.js only creates empty tables and inserts on POST/PUT/restore. The reference page opens with an empty draft and empty library (app.tsx:22 useState(''), :27 useState([]), init effect :130-133 only refreshes the list). Almost every probe is chosen by the judge at grading time ('distinctive', 'unique', 'of your choice'; functional prompt.md 'You may choose the exact fixture text'), and app_context.md:23 says not to assume an empty library and that records are identified by the server, not by title. The only literal probe named by any criterion is MULTI (functional judge.toml:101); a case-sensitive grep for MULTI over solution/ (source and built public/assets/index.js), environment/ and instruction.md returns zero hits. Initial-state strings that do exist in the reference are generic and cannot satisfy a mutation proof: default title 'Untitled' and filename 'snippet.js' (app.tsx:23-24), status 'Ready' (:33), and the starter draft inserted only by New, 'Hello, Colderwater' / 'Ready to explore.' (:98). Criteria that use New or saves demand an 'exact unique title, filename and source' (cw_save_reload_restart, cw_shared_saved_record, cw_live_library_update), so the defaults cannot stand in for the probe, and cw_basic_run_output tells the judge to clear the draft and choose its own integers (the starter draft has none). Weak-app trial: an app that pre-populates its library or editor with canned text cannot pass any save, live-update, run or multi-caret criterion, because the judge's value is unknowable in advance and MULTI must appear exactly three times after judge-chosen words. Conforming-alternative trial: an app shipping its own sample snippets is not failed, since app_context.md:23 tolerates existing records. All 22 hashes in raw-evidence-index.json match. No configured judge run exists for these exact bytes; this row is a static property of seed, criteria and reference, so that gap does not bear on it. The private check-probe-not-in-seed.py was not executed; its documented behaviour was applied by hand (the workbook says it is skipped when no sentinels are named).
